description: This Java class 'ApplicationConfig' is a Spring Boot configuration class for the Hono device registry application. It defines various beans for environment setup, including Vert.x, tracing, service endpoints, properties, security, and health check configuration.

classes.name: ApplicationConfig
classes.description: Spring Boot configuration class that sets up beans for the Device Registry application including Vert.x, Tracer, endpoints, properties, security, and health checks.

methods.name: vertx
methods.description: Provides a Vert.x instance configured with properties.

methods.name: vertxProperties
methods.description: Provides VertxProperties bean for configuration.

methods.name: getTracer
methods.description: Provides a Tracer bean resolved via TracerResolver or returns a NoopTracer if none found.

methods.name: applicationConfigProperties
methods.description: Provides general application configuration properties.

methods.name: healthCheckConfigProperties
methods.description: Provides health check server configuration properties.

methods.name: amqpProperties
methods.description: Provides AMQP protocol handler properties.

methods.name: registrationAmqpEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a new RegistrationAmqpEndpoint for device registration.

methods.name: credentialsAmqpEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a new CredentialsAmqpEndpoint for credentials management.

methods.name: tenantAmqpEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a new TenantAmqpEndpoint for tenant management.

methods.name: deviceConnectionAmqpEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a new DeviceConnectionAmqpEndpoint for device connection API.

methods.name: restProperties
methods.description: Provides REST endpoint configuration properties.

methods.name: registrationHttpEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a new DeviceManagementHttpEndpoint if DeviceManagementService bean is present.

methods.name: credentialsHttpEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a new CredentialsManagementHttpEndpoint if CredentialsManagementService bean is present.

methods.name: tenantHttpEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a new TenantManagementHttpEndpoint if TenantManagementService bean is present.

methods.name: serviceProperties
methods.description: Provides configuration properties for device registration service.

methods.name: credentialsProperties
methods.description: Provides configuration properties for credentials service.

methods.name: tenantsProperties
methods.description: Provides configuration properties for tenants service.

methods.name: deviceConnectionsProperties
methods.description: Provides configuration properties for device connection service.

methods.name: commonTags
methods.description: Configures and returns a MeterRegistryCustomizer to add common tags to metrics.

methods.name: healthCheckServer
methods.description: Provides the health check server instance.

methods.name: passwordEncoder
methods.description: Provides a HonoPasswordEncoder bean, for password encoding and matching.
